Container.Name: hisense-ac
Container.Overview: hisense-ac-bridge patched for hismart-us Fahrenheit units. Patches deiger/aircon to fix a double F-to-C-to-F conversion bug and enable retained MQTT publishes. Runs in host network mode for local device/mDNS discovery. Requires a device-specific config file (LAN key) and MQTT credentials - see the project README.
Container.Requires: Host networking. A pre-seeded config_*.json (AC unit LAN key, obtained via aircon discovery) baked into the image at build time, and an options.json with MQTT broker credentials mounted at /data/options.json.

Config.Name: Options File
Config.Description: MQTT broker connection settings (see options.json.example in the repo)
